not_found: Absolute frequency of the 640.2 nm line better than NIST: no frequency-comb measurement located.

Directly measured lifetime of 2p5 3p 2[5/2]3 (3D3): primary lifetime papers (e.g. Hartmetz & Schmoranzer) could not be opened; 19.5 ns is the Vassen-review table value. Zinner et al. only give an experimental lower limit tau >= 59 s for decay of 3D3 by channels other than 640.2 nm.
Measured lifetimes of the other 3s levels (3P0 metastable) and repumper lines: not located.

Lande g factors of the 2p5 3p levels (Giacobino, J. Physique 38, 1377 (1977), HAL jpa-00208708): the abstract confirms six measured g factors at 1e-3 precision but the PDF is behind a bot wall, so no values were copied.
Julien, Pinard, Laloe (1980) primary values for the 640.2 / 626.6 nm lines: HAL abstract found, numbers elided there; taken second-hand from Feldker et al.
Experimental reduced matrix elements / A values newer than NIST: none located.
conflicts: 3P2 lifetime: published Phys. Rev. A abstract 14.73(14) s [0.06790(64) s^-1] vs arXiv v1 of the same paper 14.70(13) s [0.06801(62) s^-1]; the published value is used. All theory values (17.1-24 s) are longer.
22-20 isotope shift of 640.2 nm: Feldker 1625.9(0.15) MHz is 2-4 MHz below every earlier measurement (1628-1632 MHz); Feldker et al. state they could not identify the reason.
notes: Isotope-shift keys 'A-B' mean nu(A) - nu(B); heavier neon isotopes lie at higher frequency on 640.2 nm. 21Ne values are hyperfine centre of gravity only where the note says so. Level energies are NIST ASD values from data/ne/levels.csv; Paschen names (1s5, 2p9) are given in the labels. Entries marked '(abstract)' were read on the publisher's abstract page only.
